segments.name: Banking
products: personal wealth management and brokerage services
segments.description: Provides community banking services, including lending, deposit, wealth management and title services, primarily to individuals, businesses and municipalities.
segments.evidence: The activities of the Company comprise one reportable segment, "Banking."

revenueModel.text: The Company earns interest income on loans and interest expense on deposits, plus noninterest income from fees for banking, wealth management and title services charged to individuals, businesses and municipalities.
revenueModel.evidence: All revenues were derived from banking operations for the years ended December 31, 2025, and 2024, and there was no customer that accounted for more than 10% of the Company's consolidated revenue.

changes.text: In December 2024, the Company completed the dissolution of four inactive subsidiaries: RFCBC, Inc., Rurbanc Data Services Inc., Rurban Mortgage Company, and SBFG Mortgage, LLC.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, the Company completed the dissolution of four of its inactive subsidiaries: RFCBC, Inc., Rurbanc Data Services Inc., Rurban Mortgage Company, and SBFG Mortgage, LLC.
